fields.title: Malawi procurement notice
fields.description: One record per notice row on one of PPDA's public boards (tenders, award-notices, intentions-to-award, debarments, admin-review-notices), or a single _error record when a keyword matches nothing or a board can't be fetched. Raw passthrough from ppda.mw's own server-rendered tables -- column presence varies by noticeType (e.g. only 'tenders' has a closingDate, only 'intentions' has a financialYear).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The keyword that produced this record, or "(all notices)" when no keyword filter was given.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-ppda-notice-tables, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_rowIndex.title: Row index
_rowIndex.description: 0-based position of this notice in PPDA's table (as published upstream).

_totalMatches.title: Total matches
_totalMatches.description: Total notices on this board matching this keyword (or total notices on the board, for "(all notices)"), before any maxResults truncation.

_truncated.title: Truncated
_truncated.description: True if _totalMatches exceeded maxResults and not every match was pushed to the dataset.

noticeType.title: Notice board
noticeType.description: Which PPDA board this record came from: tenders, awards, intentions, debarments, or admin_reviews.

title.title: Title
title.description: The notice's title, exactly as published.

institution.title: Institution
institution.description: The procuring government entity. Not present on the debarments board (debarment notices name a supplier, not a procuring institution, and PPDA's own table has no such column).

referenceNo.title: Reference number
referenceNo.description: Tender/notice reference number, exactly as published. Not present on the debarments board.

financialYear.title: Financial year
financialYear.description: Malawi government financial year the notice applies to (e.g. "2023/2024"). Only present on the 'intentions' (Intentions to Award) board.

publishDate.title: Publish date
publishDate.description: ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) date the notice was published, exactly as PPDA already publishes it (no loose-date parsing needed -- upstream dates on this site are already clean ISO strings, unlike some other portfolio targets).

closingDate.title: Closing date
closingDate.description: ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) tender closing date. Only present on the 'tenders' (Open Tenders) board.

isClosed.title: Closed
isClosed.description: True if closingDate is before today (UTC). Only computed for the 'tenders' board when closingDate parses as a valid ISO date.

attachmentUrl.title: Attachment URL
attachmentUrl.description: Direct link to the notice's PDF document, when the row's Attachment/Downloads button links to one. Omitted when no link is present on that row.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on a failed/empty job (no_results, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.
